Who I Am

Hello, I'm Gizem Özcan.

As an Industrial Engineering graduate from Istanbul Kültür University, I am a digital marketing and brand strategy professional who blends an analytical mindset with creativity. I currently work on brand communication and content strategy within the Dijitaliyidir team.

Thanks to my engineering background, I approach problems systematically and rely on data, while my marketing vision allows me to effectively bring brand stories to life in the digital world.
